continuation_context.key_insight: The CharPart/ExistPart mutual induction framework is correct and complete. CharPart propagates sorry-free through charPart_succ. The remaining mathematical work is in existPart_succ: showing that temporal truth at t on Prior structures determines the quantifier conditions of the (n+1)-var NF even when the base environment includes a witness x that differs from t. This is precisely Rabinovich's negation closure argument (Section 5, Lemma 5.1).
